description: Step 2 of 2: sends the previewed inquiry to the operator's sales team. Only call after the user explicitly confirmed the summary and privacy notice. Use a new random idempotency_key per inquiry and reuse it when retrying the same inquiry. Status accepted means we received it; it is NOT a booking and NOT a binding price — a person replies by e-mail.

idempotency_key.description: Random key, e.g. a UUID; same key for retries

user_confirmed.description: true = the user explicitly confirmed summary and privacy notice
